_doc: Tamil chant references (author's consented recordings). Selected only by shards with lang "ta" (tamil_plan.py); never read for Sanskrit. To add a clip: put the wav beside this file and fill ref_text + sec_per_syll in its entry — no code change. Half-reference rule: ref_text must match the wav EXACTLY and the wav must be <=15 s. sec_per_syll: measure with `python src/tamil_bank.py sps --wav <wav> --ref_text '<text>'`; null = not yet measured (render fails loudly).

_template.ref_text: <exact Tamil words audible in the wav>
